items.explain: '-e yol açtı' = led to + N. Tuzaklar: neden-sonuç tersine, rejection, since.
items.tip: lead to + isim; yönü kontrol et.

stem: Tacoma Narrows Köprüsü, trafiğe açıldıktan yalnızca dört ay sonra çöktü.

items.q: Türkçe cümlenin en yakın İngilizce çevirisini seçin.
options: The Tacoma Narrows Bridge was opened to traffic only four months after it collapsed.
The Tacoma Narrows Bridge has collapsed for four months since it opened.
The Tacoma Narrows Bridge collapsed only four months after it had been opened to traffic.
The Tacoma Narrows Bridge collapsed four months before it was opened to traffic.
The Tacoma Narrows Bridge had been opened to traffic for only four days.
items.explain: 'açıldıktan ... sonra' = after it had been opened; 'yalnızca dört ay' = only four months. Tuzaklar: sıra, since, before, days.

stem: Laennec, duyduğu sesleri hastalarda daha sonra bulduğu hastalıklarla ilişkilendirmek için yıllarını harcadı.

items.q: Türkçe cümlenin en yakın İngilizce çevirisini seçin.
options: Laennec spent years linking the sounds he heard to the diseases he later found in patients.
Laennec spent years finding diseases so that he could stop hearing sounds.
The diseases Laennec found in patients produced the sounds he later invented.
Laennec has spent only a few days linking sounds to diseases.
Laennec linked diseases to patients before he heard any sounds.
items.explain: spend time + Ving = -erek zaman harcamak; 'later found' = daha sonra bulduğu. Tuzaklar: so that, özne değişimi, süre, sıra.

stem: Okyanuslar, insan faaliyetlerinin saldığı karbondioksitin yaklaşık dörtte birini emer.

items.q: Türkçe cümlenin en yakın İngilizce çevirisini seçin.
options: The oceans absorb roughly a quarter of the carbon dioxide released by human activities.
The oceans release roughly a quarter of the carbon dioxide absorbed by human activities.
Human activities absorb roughly a quarter of the oceans' carbon dioxide.
The oceans absorb roughly three quarters of the carbon dioxide released by humans.
The oceans absorbed all of the carbon dioxide released by human activities.
items.explain: 'saldığı karbondioksit' = carbon dioxide released by; 'yaklaşık dörtte biri' = roughly a quarter. Tuzaklar: fiil yönü, özne, oran.
items.tip: Oran ve sayıları birebir kontrol et.

stem: Although high-strength steels allow lighter designs, they tend to be more vulnerable to hydrogen embrittlement.

items.q: Verilen cümleye anlamca en yakın cümleyi seçin.
options: Because high-strength steels are vulnerable to hydrogen embrittlement, they allow lighter designs.
High-strength steels are both lighter and completely resistant to hydrogen embrittlement.
Lighter designs make steels more vulnerable to hydrogen embrittlement unless they are high-strength.
High-strength steels are no longer used in light designs owing to hydrogen embrittlement.
High-strength steels make lighter designs possible, but they are generally more susceptible to hydrogen embrittlement.
items.explain: Although (zıtlık) ↔ but; 'tend to be' ↔ 'generally'. Tuzak: because (neden), 'completely resistant' (kutup).
items.tip: Ana bağlacın anlamını eşleştir: although = but.

stem: Green hydrogen remains more expensive than grey hydrogen.

items.q: Verilen cümleye anlamca en yakın cümleyi seçin.

Green and grey hydrogen cost exactly the same.
Grey hydrogen will soon be more expensive than green hydrogen.
Grey hydrogen is still cheaper than green hydrogen.
Green hydrogen used to be cheaper than grey hydrogen.
items.explain: A, B'den pahalı = B, A'dan ucuz; remains = still.

stem: Superconductivity would be far more widely used if it did not require such extreme cooling.

items.q: Verilen cümleye anlamca en yakın cümleyi seçin.

Superconductivity will never be used, even with cooling.
If superconductivity were used more widely, it would need less cooling.
items.explain: Type 2 koşul: soğutma gerekmeseydi yaygın olurdu = soğutma yaygınlaşmayı engelliyor.
items.tip: Gerçek dışı koşul = gerçekte tersi var.

stem: It was not until researchers designed their own guide RNA that CRISPR could be used to edit almost any gene.

items.q: Verilen cümleye anlamca en yakın cümleyi seçin.
options: Researchers designed their own guide RNA after CRISPR had been used to edit every gene.
Only after researchers designed their own guide RNA could CRISPR be used to edit almost any gene.
CRISPR could edit almost any gene before researchers designed guide RNA.
Researchers never needed guide RNA to use CRISPR.
Since CRISPR edits all genes, guide RNA was not designed.
items.explain: not until ... that = only after (devrik). Tuzak: sıra tersine, 'before'.

stem: Unless ocean temperatures fall quickly, bleached corals are likely to die.

items.q: Verilen cümleye anlamca en yakın cümleyi seçin.
options: Bleached corals will die even if ocean temperatures fall quickly.

Bleached corals will probably die if ocean temperatures do not fall quickly.
Ocean temperatures will fall quickly unless corals die.
Bleached corals never die when temperatures remain high.
items.explain: Unless = if ... not; likely to = probably.

stem: Much as the giant impact hypothesis explains many observations, it still leaves some questions unanswered.

items.q: Verilen cümleye anlamca en yakın cümleyi seçin.
options: Because the giant impact hypothesis explains everything, no questions remain.
While the giant impact hypothesis accounts for many observations, it has not answered all the questions yet.
The giant impact hypothesis explains few observations and answers no questions.
Since some questions remain, the giant impact hypothesis has been rejected.
The giant impact hypothesis leaves questions unanswered so that it can explain observations.
items.explain: Much as = although/while. 'leaves questions unanswered' = has not answered all.

stem: Doctors choose CT rather than MRI in emergencies on account of its speed.

items.q: Verilen cümleye anlamca en yakın cümleyi seçin.
options: Doctors prefer MRI in emergencies since it is faster than CT.
Since CT is faster, doctors prefer it to MRI in emergencies.

In emergencies, doctors use both CT and MRI because of their speed.
items.explain: on account of = because of; rather than = yerine (tercih).
items.tip: on account of / owing to / due to = because of.

stem: No sooner had the model been trained than it produced a ten-day forecast in about a minute.

items.q: Verilen cümleye anlamca en yakın cümleyi seçin.
options: As soon as the model was trained, it produced a ten-day forecast in about a minute.
The model was trained for ten days before producing a forecast.
The model produced a forecast long before it had been trained.
It took the model a long time to produce a forecast after training.
The model had not been trained when it produced a ten-day forecast.
items.explain: No sooner ... than = as soon as.

stem: Catalytic converters work so poorly when cold that many emissions occur in the first minutes after starting.

items.q: Verilen cümleye anlamca en yakın cümleyi seçin.
options: Catalytic converters work best when cold, so emissions are lowest after starting.
Many emissions occur after the converter warms up because it works poorly.
Although converters work poorly when cold, few emissions occur after starting.
Because catalytic converters are ineffective until they warm up, a large share of emissions occurs soon after starting.
Catalytic converters are cooled after starting in order to reduce emissions.
items.explain: so ... that = sonuç; neden-sonuç ilişkisi korunmalı.

stem: Scientists are unable to predict when earthquakes will occur.

items.q: Verilen cümleye anlamca en yakın cümleyi seçin.
options: Scientists can predict exactly when earthquakes will occur.
Earthquakes occur only when scientists predict them.
It is not possible for scientists to say in advance when earthquakes will happen.
Scientists are unwilling to predict earthquakes.
Scientists predicted every earthquake in the past.
items.explain: unable = not possible (yetersizlik). Tuzak: unwilling = istememek (farklı anlam).

stem: Had Bessemer's process removed phosphorus, early Bessemer steel would not have been so brittle.

items.q: Verilen cümleye anlamca en yakın cümleyi seçin.

Bessemer's process will remove phosphorus to make steel brittle.
Early Bessemer steel was brittle partly because the process failed to remove phosphorus.

stem: However carefully qubits are shielded, errors cannot be avoided entirely.

items.q: Verilen cümleye anlamca en yakın cümleyi seçin.
options: No matter how well qubits are protected, some errors will still occur.
If qubits are shielded carefully, errors can be avoided completely.
Qubits are shielded carefully because errors never occur.
Errors occur only when qubits are not shielded.
Shielding qubits carefully increases the number of errors.
items.explain: However + adv = No matter how; 'cannot be avoided entirely' = some errors will still occur.

stem: Tardigrades are not indestructible when they are active.

items.q: Verilen cümleye anlamca en yakın cümleyi seçin.
options: Active tardigrades can never be killed.
Tardigrades are active only when they are indestructible.
Dried tardigrades can be killed easily.
Tardigrades are never active.
Active tardigrades can be killed.

items.tip: Çift olumsuzluğu çöz: not + in- = olabilir.

stem: Plant growth in a warmer Arctic is unlikely to offset the carbon released by thawing permafrost.

items.q: Verilen cümleye anlamca en yakın cümleyi seçin.
options: Arctic plants will certainly absorb more carbon than permafrost releases.
Thawing permafrost releases carbon because Arctic plants grow faster.

The extra carbon absorbed by Arctic plants will probably not be enough to balance the carbon released as permafrost thaws.
The carbon released by permafrost will make Arctic plants die.

stem: Rust, unlike chromium oxide, does not protect the metal beneath it.

items.q: Verilen cümleye anlamca en yakın cümleyi seçin.
options: Chromium oxide protects the metal underneath, whereas rust does not.
Both rust and chromium oxide protect the metal beneath them.
Neither rust nor chromium oxide protects the metal.
Rust protects the metal better than chromium oxide does.
Chromium oxide does not protect the metal, but rust does.
items.explain: unlike = whereas ile karşıtlık; koruyan kromoksit.
